maddeler.e:
أنقلع (form VII)
# أَنْقَلِعُ (ʔanqaliʕu) /ʔan.qa.li.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
# أَنْقَلِعَ (ʔanqaliʕa) /ʔan.qa.li.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
# أَنْقَلِعْ (ʔanqaliʕ) /ʔan.qa.liʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
